name: remove-viewed-commit-badge
goal: History rows highlight the selected commit without showing a redundant Viewed commit badge.

evidence: Acceptance: remove the redundant Viewed commit pill from entity history rows while preserving the selected row highlight; applies to all entity history pages.

Coverage gap: entity-history.test.ts asserts Viewed commit is present; harness-explorer-routes.spec.ts redirects the legacy history URL to the service history page but checks only its URL. Extend that existing route flow with absence and selected-row assertions after a screenshot checkpoint.

At failing-test commit be264503, Playwright service-history route failed the unchanged badge assertion: expected 0, received 1. The checkpoint screenshot shows Viewed commit beside the selected service commit while the viewed row highlight remains.
The regression commits the exact history row behavior: remove the conditional badge, retain the viewed row class, and revise the EntityHistoryRow contract accordingly.
Unchanged Playwright route regression passed at fix commit adefacdc1 with the row still highlighted and no Viewed commit badge.
